preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function to mint MELODY tokens to your own address. The contract has a total supply cap of 47,000,000 tokens, but the owner can mint any amount up to the remaining supply. This allows the owner to arbitrarily inflate the token supply and gain tokens at no cost, potentially dumping them on the market.
